digest.en: Paramount and Warner Bros are merging under Skydance to form a new Hollywood giant. Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case as the virus surges in the DR Congo. Bulgaria reported two commercial vessels hit by drones in its economic zone.
digest.hi: फ्रांस ने पुतिन की चेतावनी के बाद नई परमाणु मिसाइल का परीक्षण किया। ट्रंप ने ईरान के खिलाफ अमेरिकी शहरों की बलि देने का ऑफर रखा।

articles.title: Paramount and Warner Bros merge to become one Hollywood giant, Skydance
articles.summary: Paramount and Warner Bros merged under David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz. The deal consolidates two major Hollywood studios into a single entity. This move concentrates industry power further among a small group of dominant players. The merger reshapes the competitive landscape for global film distribution. The merger brings two of America's oldest moviemaking studios together under the helm of billionaire David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz, in a move that is projected to concentrate power in an industry already run by just a handful of major players.

articles.title: Kenya confirms first Ebola case as virus ‘surges’ in DR Congo province
articles.summary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola death after a citizen arrived from the DRC. Health officials identified twenty-eight close contacts for monitoring. The virus continues to spread rapidly in the DRC's north-east. This marks the seventeenth known outbreak of the disease in the region. Health minister says 28 contacts identified after death of citizen who arrived from DRC on SaturdayKenya has reported its first-ever Ebola death, the health minister announced on Tuesday, as the disease continues to spread rapidly through the north-east of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where the outbreak was announced in May. This is the 17th outbreak of the highly infectious, often deadl.

articles.title: When streets become pharmacies: Booming illicit markets in Central Africa
articles.summary: Central Africa seized over 250 tonnes of illicit medical products in six years. The black market thrives due to fragile local health systems. Antibiotics, malaria treatments, and opioids circulate freely on the streets. This undermines public health efforts and regulatory oversight in the region. Antibiotics, malaria treatments, painkillers, opioids. More than 250 tonnes of medical products were seized over six years in Central Africa.

articles.title: Suspected Russian Plague Death: How Much Should We Worry?
articles.summary: A Russian laboratory technician died from suspected pneumonic plague. The incident raised global concerns about potential wider transmission. Experts assessed the risk and Russia's containment response. The case highlights vulnerabilities in handling highly infectious pathogens. A suspected case of pneumonic plague killing a laboratory technician in Russia has sparked global alarm about the possibility of wider transmission. RFE/RL spoke to Brendan Wren, a professor of microbial pathogenesis, about the situation and Russia's moves to deal with it.

articles.title: Argentina will stop Falklands exploiting offshore oilfields, foreign minister says
articles.summary: Argentina announced it will block Falkland Islands offshore oil exploitation. Foreign minister Pablo Quirno stated this move asserts sovereignty. The declaration was made to an audience including the British ambassador. This action escalates diplomatic tensions over the disputed territory. Pablo Quirno says move is part of Argentinian government’s strategy to peacefully assert sovereignty over the islandsArgentina’s foreign minister has told an audience that included the British ambassador that his government would stop the Falkland Islands from exploiting its offshore oilfields as part of a strategy to take sovereignty. During a speech at a thinktank event in the Argentinian capital.

articles.title: Bulgarian Prime Minister says two commercial vessels hit by drones in economic zone
articles.summary: Bulgarian Prime Minister reported two commercial vessels struck by drones in the economic zone. The Togo-flagged Alfa Watan suffered critical structural damage and sank immediately. Officials have not yet confirmed the fate of the crew members aboard the vessel. One of the ships, the Alfa Watan, which flew the flag of Togo, suffered critical structural damage and sank on the spot.

articles.title: CPEC 2.0 will be won or lost on keeping China’s investors safe
articles.summary: CPEC 2.0 shifts focus from fixed infrastructure to industry, agriculture, and private business. This transition complicates security for Chinese investors in Pakistan. Protecting dispersed industrial zones and mines requires different strategies than guarding large, static construction sites. CPEC 2.0 aims to move past the infrastructure-heavy first phase toward industry, agriculture, mining, technology, green development and business-to-business investment. That shift could deepen economic ties between Pakistan and China, but it also changes the nature of the security challenge.

articles.title: Flávio’s surprise first-round election win highlights rapid rise of Brazil’s House of Bolsonaro
articles.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro won the first round of Brazil’s presidential election. Four members of his family now hold office. The victory extends Jair Bolsonaro’s political influence. The result signals the rise of a new political dynasty in the country. Four members of disgraced ex-president Jair Bolsonaro’s family have been elected to office, most notably his wife and son Flávio, who won the first round of voting to be Brazil’s new presidentThe weekend’s elections in Brazil not only put Jair Bolsonaro’s eldest son, Flávio Bolsonaro, in the lead in the presidential race, but also underscored how far the former president has come in building a pol.

articles.title: From competing for food to a gold medal: the stories behind India’s Asian Games winners
articles.summary: India won eighty-five medals at the Asian Games in Japan. The haul included twenty-one gold medals. Many athletes trained with limited funds and borrowed equipment. The results highlighted the country’s broad sporting talent beyond cricket. The country’s 85-medal haul included athletes who trained with limited money and borrowed equipment. Plus, the Mumbai performer turning everyday absurdities into comedyIn a country where cricket eclipses every other sport, the recently concluded Asian Games offered a much-needed reminder of India’s breadth of sporting talent.

articles.title: Russian Computers, US Phones, Hunter Biden's Laptop, Cracked By Powerful Russian-Made Software
articles.summary: Dozens of US and European agencies, including the FBI, used hacking software from Russian-owned Oxygen Forensics. A former agent utilized the tool to extract thousands of hidden files from Hunter Biden's laptop. The software facilitated access to encrypted data across multiple government bodies. Powerful phone hacking software built by Russian-owned Oxygen Forensics was used by dozens of US and European government agencies, including the FBI and the Secret Service.

articles.title: Tigray rebel groups ‘forcibly recruiting boys as young as 15’ as fighting spreads
articles.summary: A new Tigray rebel alliance is forcibly recruiting boys as young as fifteen. Fighting resumed on 23 September, threatening a fresh humanitarian crisis in northern Ethiopia. Civilians are fleeing as armed groups round up men and boys on the streets. Civilians try to flee as men and boys rounded up on streets by new alliance as Ethiopia conflict erupts againAs renewed fighting has threatened a fresh humanitarian crisis in the northern region of Ethiopia, reports are emerging that a new alliance of armed groups in Tigray has been forcibly recruiting men and boys to its ranks. Renewed conflict erupted on 23 September between Ethiopia’s federal go.

articles.title: Sustaining Northeast Asia trilateral deterrence
articles.summary: US, South Korean, and Japanese planners have institutionalized trilateral security cooperation. However, deterrence credibility depends on wartime sustainment capabilities. The three nations have expanded joint exercises to address this critical operational variable. Originally published by Pacific Forum, this article is republished with permission. While operational planners in the United States, the Republic of Korea and Japan have made historic strides institutionalizing trilateral security cooperation, the credibility of deterrence ultimately hinges on a more punishing variable: wartime sustainment.

articles.title: Far right on the march and Lula’s failures: key drivers of Flávio Bolsonaro’s Brazil surge
articles.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro won Brazil's first-round election, driven by evangelical support and President Lula's perceived rigidity. The 80-year-old incumbent's failures amplified the far-right surge. Rio's leftwing neighborhoods now chant for a political reversal. Experts say strength of evangelical church and stubbornness of Lula, 80, also helped propel Jair Bolsonaro’s son to first-round election winOn Sunday night, as the scale of the far-right triumph in Brazil sank in, an adapted football chant rang out in one of Rio’s most leftwing areas.“Let’s turn this around, Lu-laaaaa!

articles.title: 'Don't You Have A Smart TV?': Iranian General's Smartwatch Defense Fuels Security Concerns
articles.summary: Iranian General Gholamreza Jalali faced backlash for wearing a smartwatch. He defended the choice by noting it is peacetime and citizens own smart TVs. The incident intensified criticism of lax security protocols among Iran’s senior military leadership. A photo of Brigadier General Gholamreza Jalali, the head of Iran's Passive Defense Organization, wearing a smartwatch has sparked a backlash. His response, that it's peacetime and people have smart TVs at home, has only fueled criticism of lax security among Iran's top brass.

articles.title: Protesters, Police Clash As Vote On President And Kosovo War Crimes Court Stalls
articles.summary: Kosovo’s parliament approved a bill to restrict the Hague tribunal’s jurisdiction. This occurred on October 5, the day before the presidential election deadline. Failure to elect a leader will trigger fresh parliamentary elections. Kosovo’s parliament approved at first reading a bill to sharply restrict the jurisdiction of the Hague-based Kosovo Specialist Chambers on October 5, a day before a deadline to elect a new president or face fresh parliamentary elections.

articles.title: Guardian readers fund life-changing surgery for Somali boy injured in US airstrike
articles.summary: Guardian readers funded life-saving surgery for Abdiqadir Salah, a seven-year-old Somali boy injured in a US drone strike. The operation took place in Mogadishu after an investigation revealed the attack killed twelve civilians. The boy’s mother described the hospital journey as a moment of mixed joy and apprehension. After Guardian investigation uncovered drone strike that killed 12 civilians and injured many more, seven-year-old Abdiqadir Salah underwent vital operation in MogadishuOn the rickshaw ride to the hospital, Marian Haji Abdi Guled felt a mixture of joy and apprehension: the day they had been waiting for had finally arrived. Almost a year earlier, her then seven-year-old son, Abdiqadir Salah, had bee.

articles.title: ‘Nothing can justify these atrocities,’ says Guterres three years on from 7 October attacks
articles.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres stated nothing justifies the atrocities committed on 7 October. Speaking three years after the initial attacks, he called for an end to the suffering of both Israelis and Palestinians in the ongoing conflict. Three years after Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups attacked Israel, UN Secretary-General António Guterres has said nothing can justify the atrocities of 7 October – calling for an end to the suffering of Israelis and Palestinians alike.

articles.title: ‘The clock on AI regulation is ticking’, warns UN rights chief
articles.summary: UN High Commissioner Volker Türk warned the world is running out of time to regulate artificial intelligence. He described a ruthless race between companies and countries that threatens human safety and survival without proper guardrails. The world is running out of time to put guardrails on artificial intelligence, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk warned Monday, as a “ruthless race” between companies and countries raises concerns about human safety and even humanity’s survival.

articles.title: Quebec poised to elect separatists to power for first time in more than a decade
articles.summary: Quebec voters are likely to elect the Parti Québécois to power for the first time in over a decade. The separatist party promises to hold an independence referendum by 2028. This would be the first such vote in Canada’s French-speaking region in many years. Parti Québécois promises to hold independence referendum in Canada’s French-speaking region by 2028Voters in Quebec are going to the polls in provincial elections which will probably result in victory for a party that has promised to hold a referendum on independence from Canada within the next two years. If polls are correct, the Parti Québécois (PQ) will form the government of the province of rou.

articles.title: Siberian Anti-Plague Institute Staff Isolated After Worker's Death
articles.summary: US officials monitor reports of a suspected pneumonic plague case in Russia’s Irkutsk region. A twenty-eight-year-old laboratory worker at the Siberian Anti-Plague Institute died, leading to staff isolation. Some US politicians now call for sweeping travel restrictions involving Russia. The United States is monitoring reports of a suspected case of pneumonic plague in Russia after the death of a 28-year-old laboratory worker in the Siberian region of Irkutsk, as some US political figures call for sweeping travel restrictions involving Russia.

articles.title: Rubio Heads To NATO Allies As Russian Threat, Middle East War Shape Agenda
articles.summary: Marco Rubio visits Iceland, Greece, and Portugal from October 5 to 8. He discusses security, defense, and energy with NATO partners. The agenda addresses Russian military activity and Middle East instability. These talks aim to strengthen allied cooperation on key strategic issues. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is heading to Iceland, Greece, and Portugal on October 5-8 for talks on security, defense, energy, economic cooperation, and technology as NATO allies face growing security concerns over Russia’s military activity and continued Middle East instability.

articles.title: Nationalist Parties, Dodik Dominate Bosnian Election Amid Low Turnout
articles.summary: Milorad Dodik declared victory for his party in Bosnia's Serbian-led entity. Nationalist parties also won seats in the country's complex electoral system. Turnout was low. The results are likely to sustain high tensions across Bosnia and the wider region. Milorad Dodik, the Russia-friendly former leader of Bosnia-Herzegovina's Serbian-led entity, declared victory for his party in the region, with nationalist forces also scoring wins in Bosnia's complex electoral system -- results likely to keep tensions high in the country and the region.

articles.title: How a film brought a UN report to life in Xochimilco
articles.summary: A documentary based on United Nations University research screened at COP30 and European film festivals. The film returned to Xochimilco, the Mexico City canals where it was shot. This journey highlighted the local impact of the climate data presented in the report. A documentary drawn from United Nations University research was screened at the COP30 climate conference and film festivals across Europe.

articles.title: On Our Radar
articles.summary: Crisis Group's weekly radar highlights global conflicts and crises. Field experts identify under-reported trends and major developments. They explain why specific hotspots matter and outline necessary actions for stakeholders. On Our Radar scans conflicts and crises around the globe every week and features some of the hotspots Crisis Group’s analysts are closely watching. Whether an under-reported trend or a headline-grabbing development, our field experts explain why it matters or what should be done.

articles.title: Five Energy Market Factors That Could Tip the Scales in the Middle East War
articles.summary: Oil and gas prices are central to the US-Israeli conflict with Iran. Washington aims to lower prices while Tehran seeks to keep them high. Five specific market developments could determine whether the fighting escalates or de-escalates. Oil, gas and fuel prices are central to the U. S.-Israeli war with Iran, with Washington striving to lower them and Tehran to keep them high.

articles.summary: खैबर पख्तूनख्वा में आतंकियों ने पांच सरकारी अधिकारियों को मार गिराया। सेना ने हाल के महीनों में कई आतंकी कार्रवाई की, लेकिन हिंसा रुकी नहीं। सुरक्षाबलों और अधिकारियों को निशाना बनाने का सिलसिला जारी है। कुछ नेताओं की हरकतें साफ दिखाती हैं कि इन्हें जनता के पैसों और सरकारी तंत्र से कोई मतलब नहीं है. जब मन किया, इमरजेंसी फायर ब्रिगेड को अपनी कार या बंगला धोने की मशीन बना लिया और इसे पोछे की तरह इस्‍तेमाल कर लिया.

articles.summary: कुछ नेताओं ने आपातकालीन फायर ब्रिगेड के वाहनों का उपयोग निजी कारों और घरों को धोने के लिए किया। इस घटना ने सरकारी संसाधनों के दुरुपयोग और वीआईपी संस्कृति को उजागर किया। जनता की समस्याओं को नजरअंदाज करके यह कार्रवाई की गई। इंडोनेशिया में आज एक दर्दनाक रोड एक्सीडेंट का मामला सामने आया है। ईस्ट नुसा तेंगारा (East Nusa Tenggara) के लेम्बाटा रीजेंसी (Lembata Regency) में आज, मंगलवार, 6 अक्टूबर को बाउपाना गांव से बनिटोबो गांव के रास्ते पर रेत ले जा रहा डंप ट्रक पलट गया।

articles.summary: चीन तुर्कमेनिस्तान को एडवांस एयर डिफेंस सिस्टम बेच रहा है। रूस इस बढ़ती चीनी मौजूदगी को स्वीकार नहीं कर रहा। क्षेत्र में हथियारों की दौड़ तेज हो गई है और भारत की मिसाइल प्रविधि भी इसमें शामिल है। हथियारों के बाजार में अब रूस और चीन आमने-सामने आ गए हैं. बाजी लगी है सेंट्रल एशिया की. चीन लगातार तुर्कमेनिस्तान को अपने एडवांस एयर डिफेंस सिस्टम बेच रहा है.

articles.title: ‘इज़रायल मिडिल ईस्ट में सबसे शक्तिशाली देश, हमारे दुश्मन हुए पहले से कहीं ज़्यादा कमजोर’ – बेंजामिन
articles.summary: इज़रायल के प्रधानमंत्री ने कहा कि दुश्मन अब पहले से कमजोर हैं। हमास के अधिकांश नेता मारे जा चुके हैं। गाज़ा में सैन्य कार्रवाई के बाद आतंकी संगठन भारी नुकसान उठा चुका है। फिलिस्तीनी आतंकी संगठन हमास (Hamas) ने 7 अक्टूबर 2023 को इज़रायल (Israel) पर हमला करते हुए जंग की शुरुआत की थी। हमास से बदला लेने के लिए इज़रायल ने गाज़ा (Gaza) और आसपास के फिलिस्तीनी इलाकों में सैन्य कार्रवाई शुरू की और तबाही मचा दी।

articles.summary: फ्रांस ने पुतिन की परमाणु चेतावनी के बाद नई मिसाइल का परीक्षण किया। यह कदम यूक्रेन संकट में पश्चिम की सुरक्षा रणनीति को मजबूत करने का प्रयास है। रूस के राष्ट्रपति व्लादिमीर पुतिन ने पिछले हफ्ते पश्चिमी देशों को चेतावनी दी थी कि यूक्रेन मुद्दे पर तनाव बढ़ाने से बचें। उन्होंने कलिनिनग्राद की सुरक्षा के लिए परमाणु हथियार इस्तेमाल करने की बात तक कही थी।

articles.summary: रुबियो ने स्पष्ट किया कि यूक्रेन की नाटो सदस्यता पर चर्चा नहीं हो रही। अमेरिका का मुख्य लक्ष्य इस लंबे युद्ध को समाप्त करना है। रूस-यूक्रेन युद्ध (Russia-Ukraine War) को 4 साल से ज़्यादा समय बीत चुका है, लेकिन अभी भी इसके खत्म होने की उम्मीद लगभग न के बराबर है। दोनों देश एक-दूसरे पर हमले कर रहे हैं। रूस ज़्यादा हमले कर रहा है, लेकिन यूक्रेन भी हाथ पर हाथ रखने के बजाय जवाबी कार्रवाई कर रहा है।

articles.title: बांग्लादेश में शेख हसीना के समर्थकों के साथ आखिर क्या हो रहा है? सरकार-पुलिस कार्रवाई पर उठे सवाल!
articles.summary: बांग्लादेश में शेख हसीना के समर्थकों पर पुलिस की कार्रवाई से मानवाधिकार संगठनों ने चिंता जताई है। ह्यूमन राइट्स वॉच ने राजनीतिक स्वतंत्रता के उल्लंघन पर सवाल उठाए हैं। पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री शेख हसीना के समर्थकों पर पुलिस की कार्रवाई को लेकर सवाल उठ रहे हैं। बड़ी संख्या में लोगों की गिरफ्तारी ने मानवाधिकार संगठनों की चिंता बढ़ा दी है। अमेरिका की ‘ह्यूमन राइट्स वॉच’ (HRW) ने सरकार की कार्रवाई पर गंभीर सवाल उठाए हैं।

articles.title: हूतियों को भारी पड़ रहा सऊदी का ये 45 साल पुराना F-15E, जानें क्यों है खास?
articles.summary: सऊदी अरब ने यमन में हूतियों के खिलाफ 45 साल पुराने F-15E जेट का इस्तेमाल किया। लगातार अपग्रेड के बाद यह हथियार अब भी प्रभावी साबित हो रहा है। यमन में हूती विद्रोहियों के खिलाफ सऊदी अरब ने अपना सैन्य अभियान तेज कर दिया है. इस ऑपरेशन में F-15 फाइटर जेट की भूमिका चर्चा में है. करीब 40-45 साल पुराने इस फाइटर जेट को लगातार अपग्रेड किया गया है.

articles.title: बांग्लादेश की राजधानी ढाका बना दुनिया का सबसे प्रदूषित शहर
articles.summary: ढाका दुनिया का सबसे प्रदूषित शहर बन गया है। 6 अक्टूबर को सुबह 11:10 बजे एयर क्वालिटी इंडेक्स 213 दर्ज हुआ। स्थानीय मीडिया की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार यह स्तर सबसे ऊंचा है। बांग्लादेश (Bangladesh) की राजधानी ढाका (Dhaka) दुनिया का सबसे प्रदूषित शहर बन गया है। स्थानीय मीडिया की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, आज, मंगलवार, 6 अक्टूबर को सुबह 11:10 बजे (स्थानीय समय) 213 एयर क्वालिटी इंडेक्स (AQI) के साथ ढाका दुनिया के सबसे प्रदूषित शहरों की लिस्ट में पहले स्थान पर पहुंच गया।

articles.title: दोषी पाए गए तो भुगतना होगा खामियाजा- ईरान को ट्रंप की खुली चेतावनी
articles.summary: ट्रंप ने ईरान को सीधी चेतावनी दी है। ब्रिटेन में अमेरिकी ठिकानों के खतरे में ईरान की भूमिका मिलने पर परिणाम गंभीर होंगे। बातचीत का रास्ता भी खुला रखा गया है। Donald Trump Iran Warning: अमेरिका और ईरान के बीच तनाव एक बार फिर बढ़ता दिख रहा है। अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप ने तेहरान को सीधी चेतावनी दी है। उन्होंने कहा कि अगर ब्रिटेन में अमेरिकी सैन्य ठिकानों से जुड़े सुरक्षा खतरों के पीछे ईरान का हाथ पाया गया, तो उसे गंभीर परिणाम भुगतने पड़ सकते हैं।

articles.title: हूती विद्रोहियों ने सऊदी अरब को दहलाया, कई जगह किए हमले
articles.summary: यमन के हूती विद्रोहियों ने सऊदी अरब पर हमले शुरू किए। सरकारी सेना के हमलों के जवाब में यह कार्रवाई हुई। सोमवार की शाम से हमले जारी हैं। यमन (Yemen) के हूती विद्रोहियों (Houthis) के खिलाफ सऊदी अरब (Saudi Arabia) समर्थित यमन की सरकारी सेना के हमलों के बाद अब हूतियों ने बदला लेने के लिए सऊदी अरब पर एक बार फिर हमले शुरू कर दिए हैं।

articles.title: न्यूजीलैंड में क्या गुल खिला रहा था ओमानी को-पायलट? 175 दिन तक रहा, अब रिकॉर्ड खंगाल रही पुलिस
articles.summary: फ्लाईदुबई के को-पायलट हमाम अल-हमामी की न्यूजीलैंड यात्रा की जांच हो रही है। वह 2018-19 में 175 दिन वहां रहा था। पुलिस उसकी गतिविधियों का पता लगा रही है। FlyDubai Co-pilot New Zealand Connection: फ्लाईदुबई की फ्लाइट FZ1073 में ओमानी को-पायलट हमाम अल-हमामी ने कैप्टन स्मित मच्छर पर हमला कर प्लेन को क्रैश करने जो खतरनाक मंसूबे पाले थे, अब उसके हर पहलू की जांच हो रही थी.
